program.section_heading: Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Associate of Science Degree
program.ge_pattern: SBVC General Education and Graduation Requirements or Cal-GETC - California General Education Transfer Curriculum
outcomes: Select and operate the required test equipment and during troubleshooting and repair operations, with an emphasis on safety in use and accuracy in results.
Analyze, interpret, and trace signal flow diagrams used in signal tracing of complex wiring circuits.
Effectively communicate with and advise customers and co-workers, both written and orally, regarding the progress of and decisions made concerning test and repair procedures.
Pass the practice RSES and NATE exam on the theory and procedures of the HVAC/R technology.

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (HVAC/R 001, TECALC 087); these match closed-list HVAC/R 1-6 and TECALC 87.
HVAC/R 007 (Welding for HVAC/R, 3 units) is required in the catalog but not in the closed list.

The required list also includes 'Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Universal Certification (608)' with no units; it is a certification, not a course, and is not recorded as a block entry. Students must present a copy to Admissions and Records.
No units printed beside TECALC 087 (alternative to MATH 102); closed list stores 4.
degree_total 60 taken from '(minimum total = 60 units)' in the sentence describing this award's graduation requirements; reviewer may judge it a generic AS-degree minimum instead.
The degree requires completing all certificate requirements plus GE; the page names two GE patterns (SBVC GE or Cal-GETC) without unit figures.
Program learning outcomes come from the page's outcomes tab and appear to apply to this award.
